description: Central Bank of Sri Lanka  (foreign exchange) - Foreign Exchange Act, No. 12. of 2017 permitted to issue International Sovereign Bonds in 2018
categorisation: This gazette contains regulations made under the Foreign Exchange Act, No. 12 of 2017, specifically permitting the government to issue International Sovereign Bonds. This constitutes subsidiary legislation and regulatory matters, falling squarely under Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5). While it includes a minister's name, this is a standard legal notification format and does not involve government personnel changes or detailed portfolio responsibilities that would trigger a government-related classification.
